description: Canonical experience-ladder classifier. After null, non-finite, and all-zero cascades are assigned UNCLASSED, each eligible operator is assigned to exactly one stage by a descending first-match scan over totalMin thresholds. The first match wins and all thresholds are inclusive lower bounds (>=). Within each tier, III is entry, II is intermediate, and I is the top sub-stage.
cohort: All operators with non-null, finite total_tokens and at least one non-zero pillar. This is a population-agnostic classifier — the same thresholds apply regardless of which cohort is being classified.

unclassified.condition: total_tokens is null, non-finite, or all four pillars are zero
unclassified.note: Distinct from IGNITER III so callers can distinguish 'no data' from 'bottom tier'.

transmitter_badge.description: TRANSMITTER is a temporary peak badge (RS.08) that any experience tier can earn during a high-frequency, high-resonance window. It lapses when frequency or resonance drops. It is not a permanent class and is not part of the 24-stage ladder.

calibration: Thresholds were calibrated against the field distribution using Option C target shares: IGNITER 10%, BEARER 12.5%, REFINER 15%, SEEKER 22.5%, BASE 20%, POWER 15%, ARCH 5%, and ARCH+ aspirational. Each ordinary base tier is divided approximately into thirds (III, II, I). The thresholds are fixed classifier cutpoints — they do not change with the population.
